title: Oura Ring
description: Warm wellness paper: a cream page with sand panels, warm dark-grey type and pill buttons, one sparing electric blue for the main CTA, and a near-black warm ink for the press band and footer. A narrow, light editorial serif for headings over a Swiss neo-grotesk. Dark is the ink band widened to the whole page: cream type and cream pills on warm near-black.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the press band and the footer force themselves dark with the dark class
Public Sans stands in for AkkuratLL (closed) and Instrument Serif for Editorial New (closed)
